# Vendored libraries

Served from this folder so the site needs no CDN or build step.

| File | Version | License |
|---|---|---|
| `gsap.min.js` | GSAP 3.15.0 | GSAP Standard "No Charge" License, https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | ScrollTrigger 3.15.0 | GSAP Standard "No Charge" License, https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `lenis.min.js` | Lenis 1.3.26 | MIT, (c) 2024 darkroom.engineering, https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis |

To update: `npm i gsap lenis`, then copy `node_modules/gsap/dist/{gsap,ScrollTrigger}.min.js` and `node_modules/lenis/dist/lenis.min.js` here.
